relations.text: 中国でのMYQORZOの販売を担う。承認で1,500万ドルのマイルストーン
relations.text_en: Commercializes MYQORZO in China; paid $15 million in approval milestones

source.label: Cytokinetics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We depend on Sanofi for commercialization of MYQORZO in China.

relations.text: 日本でaficamtenの第3相試験を実施
relations.text_en: Runs a Phase 3 aficamten trial in Japan

source.label: Cytokinetics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The first patient was dosed in Bayer's Phase 3 clinical trial in oHCM, CAMELLIA-HCM, in Japan in the third quarter of 2025.

relations.text: omecamtiv mecarbilの第3相試験GALACTIC-HFを共同で実施
relations.text_en: Ran the GALACTIC-HF Phase 3 trial of omecamtiv mecarbil in collaboration

source.label: Cytokinetics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: GALACTIC-HF GALACTIC-HF is a Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes clinical trial of omecamtiv mecarbil that was conducted by Amgen in collaboration with Cytokinetics.
